author: evac
description: Gated access to the Rabbit Hole (adult image channels). A cryptic button in Pillow Talk plus daily random invitations grant the Rabbit Hole role to members who hold Adult Chat, an 18+ age role and reach the configured LevelUp level. Members then opt into interest channels with toggle buttons; interest access is removed after a warning if they never post or react there, and re-entry goes through ModMail. Includes an exclude list that blocks every route and revokes access, automatic revocation on leaving / losing Adult Chat / gaining the underage role, a dry-run sweep with a circuit breaker, and per-user-overwrite or role-based interest access.
install_msg:
Thanks for installing afterdark!

First-time setup (IDs for Adult Chat, the Rabbit Hole role, the age roles, Pillow Talk and #mod-commands are pre-filled):
1. `.afterdark` opens the control panel. Roles & channels shows anything MISSING; Interests adds the channels people can opt into (access is per-user, no role needed).
2. `.afterdark post` puts the rabbit button in Pillow Talk; `.afterdark panel #rules-channel` posts the member buttons.
3. The sweep starts as a DRY RUN: `.afterdark sweep` shows what it would do in #mod-commands. When it looks right, switch Access & sweep to Live.
4. Daily invitations are OFF until you turn them on in the Invitations tab. Nothing is sent until a mod approves each one.

Mod commands: grant, revoke, grantinterest, revokeinterest, exclude, unexclude, clear, check, status. Probe the build: `.afterdark version`.
name: AfterDark
short: Gated Rabbit Hole access: button + invitations, interest opt-ins, inactivity cleanup, exclude list.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs and timestamps: who holds Rabbit Hole access and how they got it, per-interest join and last-activity times, the exclude list (with the moderator's reason), members who declined an invitation, members whose interest access lapsed, and outstanding invitations. It stores no message content.
